title: Your saved searches
description: Catalog searches you have saved, with the filters that were active.

help.title: About Saved searches
help.overview: A saved search stores a catalog filter a customer can run again. It is not a product and not an order. It remembers how they wanted the catalog narrowed.

sections.title: What is stored
sections.body: The name is the label. The rest is the filter.
items: Categories can be several. Collection is one.
Minimum price, maximum price, and sort are optional. Empty ones are simply not applied.

sections.title: Whose searches this page shows
sections.body: The same records are listed two ways.
items: Opened from the eCommerce menu, this page lists every saved search in the company, and a new one asks which customer it belongs to.
Opened as a customer's own list, it shows only theirs, and a new search is filed under that customer.
Deleting a saved search is a soft delete and it can be restored.

sections.title: What it does not do
sections.body: Saving a search does not change the catalog.
items: It does not hide products, change a price, or create a collection.
Categories, collections, and prices are edited on those pages. This row only points at them.
Running it again applies the same filter to the catalog as it is now, not as it was when the search was saved.

catalogDescription: Every catalog search saved by a customer.
